notes: With every cohort now expressible as a screen (3.18.0), the screening capability moves where it belongs — inside Cohorts. Your saved screens migrate to cohorts. On the next Cohorts load, each becomes a screen-defined cohort carrying an *inline* copy of its predicates — self-contained, so it survives the standalone screener being retired next. It's idempotent and non-destructive (the saved screen stays until then), and shipped preset screens aren't migrated, since those are examples rather than your own groups.
